# Swift Chat

> The Messages app, as a SwiftUI view, for conversations with people and with AI agents. Swift Chat is an iOS 18+ Swift package by Union St that renders an iMessage-faithful chat transcript from your own message models: bubble tails, typing indicators, delivery and read receipts, attachments, keyboard handling, pagination, group chats, dark mode. For an agent it adds streaming Markdown replies, a status line through tool calls, results as SwiftUI views, suggestions, and turn-taking.

Install: https://github.com/unionst/swift-chat.git (product "SwiftChat"). `import SwiftChat`. Formerly UnionChat; `import UnionChat` still works.

## Docs

- [Full reference](https://unionst.com/swiftchat/llms-full.txt): every initializer and modifier with examples
- [README](https://github.com/unionst/swift-chat#readme): quick start and feature list
- [API documentation](https://www.swiftipedia.org/documentation/unionchat): generated symbol docs
- [Website](https://unionst.com/swiftchat)

## Minimal example

```swift
import SwiftUI
import SwiftChat

Chat(messages) { message in
    Message(message.text, role: message.role, timestamp: message.sentAt)
        .messageStatus(message.status)
}
.chatTypingIndicators(typing)
.chatInputPlaceholder("iMessage")
.chatInputCapabilities([.photoLibrary, .files])
.onChatSend { text, media in
    await conversation.send(text, media)
}
```

## Assistant style

For an assistant thread: the sent message rises to the top of the screen and the reply streams in beneath it as bare, full-width Markdown whose words fade in one after another. Append one message for the reply and rewrite its text as tokens arrive. The typing indicator is a ring spinner; `chatTypingStatus(_:)` adds a status line beside it. Photos in replies run full width; `messageAttachment { }` views draw bare. Own bubbles are gray, the field is taller, the send button is `.primary`; override with `chatBubbleStyle`, `chatInputBarHeight`, `chatInputControlTint`; set `.font` on the `Message` for reply text. `chatInputCapabilities([.camera, .photoLibrary, .files])` for the plus menu.

```swift
Chat(thread.messages, typingUsers: thread.thinking ? [assistant] : []) { message in
    Message(message.text, role: message.role, timestamp: message.sentAt)
}
.chatStyle(.assistant)
.chatTypingStatus(thread.status)
```

## Agent chats

Swift Chat draws an AI agent's thread as well as a conversation between people. It has no model or networking inside it; these pieces draw the agent you run. Full guide: https://github.com/unionst/swift-chat/blob/main/Documentation/agents.md

- Stream a reply: append one message and rewrite its text as tokens arrive, keeping its id. Markdown in the assistant style.
- Status through tool calls: `.chatTypingStatus("Searching")` beside the spinner while the agent is in `typingUsers`; a new line rolls the old one away; `nil` for the spinner alone. In the messages style use `ChatHeader(title:subtitle:)`.
- Results as views: `Message(...).messageAttachment { AnySwiftUIView() }` puts a card in the thread (bare and full width in the assistant style); its controls are live.
- Suggestions: `.chatInputSuggestions([ChatInputSuggestion(text:systemImage:)])` stacks chips above the field while nothing is typed and `.onChatInputSuggestionTap { suggestion in }` hands you the tap, which you send yourself. A `Message` with `.messageStyle(.suggestion)` is a dashed bubble in the thread; tapping it sends its text through the bar and it arrives in `onChatSend`, so remove the suggestion rows there and do not send again.
- Turn-taking for an agent that texts in bubbles: `ChatAssistantTurns(exchange:deliver:shelve:fail:)` with `.chatAssistantTurns(turns)`, `typingUsers: turns.typingUsers(agent)`, and `turns.noteSent()` after appending the person's message. The dots wait 1.6 s after a send, the reply is held while the person is typing, a burst of messages becomes one `exchange`, a reply to a message since followed up goes to `shelve`, and lines are delivered one at a time. Timings are `ChatAssistantPacing`.

```swift
Chat(thread.messages, typingUsers: thread.working ? [agent] : []) { message in
    if let result = message.result {
        Message(message.text, role: message.role, timestamp: message.sentAt)
            .messageAttachment { ResultCard(result) }
    } else {
        Message(message.text, role: message.role, timestamp: message.sentAt)
    }
}
.chatStyle(.assistant)
.chatTypingStatus(thread.status)
.chatInputSuggestions(thread.messages.isEmpty ? thread.openers : [])
.onChatInputSuggestionTap { suggestion in
    thread.send(suggestion.text)
}
.onChatSend { text, media in
    await thread.send(text, media)
}
```
